title: Locating critical points attracted to p-adic attracting cycles
summary: In complex dynamics, a fundamental result of Fatou and Julia asserts that every attracting cycle of a rational map attracts a critical point. The analogous statement fails in non-Archimedean dynamics. For a non-Archimedean rational map, this paper establishes a sharp condition on the multiplier of an attracting cycle ensuring it attracts a critical point.
